_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fs3i#4, and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The rule holds — FS3I fluid elements need the ALE kinematic flag — but the quoted message does not exist. Rewriting all 320 fluid element lines of upstream fs3i_part_1wc_infperm.4C.yaml from 'NA ALE' to 'NA Euler' aborts in coupling/src/adapter/4C_coupling_adapter.cpp line 69 with 'got 42 master nodes but 0 slave nodes for coupling': the ALE discretisation is never built from Eulerian fluid elements, so the FSI interface has nothing to couple to. The log contains no occurrence of 'kinematic' or 'moving mesh' at all, and no time step is reached. The entry also writes the flag as a YAML key 'NA: Euler', which does not correspond to the deck format — it is an element-line token. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: got 42 master nodes but 0 slave nodes for coupling
